sourceName: Maxroll Runewords Overview + Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet
notes: Runes go in 2-socket Helms, Chest Armor, Pants and 2H Weapons: one Rune of Ritual plus one Rune of Invocation makes a runeword.
A character can have at most 2 runewords. You can't repeat a rune, pair two runes of the same type, or mix gems and runes in one item.
Classic runewords (Enigma, Grief...) are crafted in the Horadric Cube from a normal-quality base item plus runes. An Ancestral base gives an Ancestral runeword.
